ditrih_88: The new rifleman gave his name as Marek Ditrih. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Marek Ditrih signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.

Dorian Austintress lent Marek Ditrih a pencil. The returned pencil came wrapped in a scrap of paper marked 'One good turn'. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Marek Ditrih looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell landed close to R-F12. When the dust settled Marek Ditrih was still there, holding a bullet that missed him, laughing without sound.
Marek Ditrih cut Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Dawn watch. Marek Ditrih put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, grazed.
dj_triplejjj1120: "You're late," said the corporal when Teodor Triplejjj arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Isidor Serrano's name scratched on it. Teodor Triplejjj kicked it back. It did not come again.
Teodor Triplejjj accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
j14ar08g06: The quartermaster asked Valentin Jarg to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Valentin Jarg and Arno Isaacburston argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
jiri.satalik: Bram Satalik took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bram Satalik was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Bram Satalik put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Bram Satalik during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet clipped Bram Satalik's helmet at R-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Bram Ahmadhcj of the Hegemony (@ahmadhcj07).
Bram Satalik's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Bram Satalik watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
yurboixav: Wendel Yurboixav took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Wendel Yurboixav was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Wendel Yurboixav did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F11. Wendel Yurboixav took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy).
An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Wendel Yurboixav was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
The man in the next bed snored all day. Wendel Yurboixav did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing.
